title: Reading practice

format.lessons: one entry per lesson, in course order; lesson matches 'l' in app/words.json (1.1 to 20.2, no 11.2)
format.passages: two per lesson: a dialogue and a short story (kind: 'dialogue' or 'story')
format.title: {zh, py, en}
format.lines: one per sentence or speaking turn: {speaker?, speaker_py?, zh, py, en}; speaker is only on dialogue lines
format.text: all line zh joined, for listening mode (read it aloud with zh-CN speech, text hidden)
format.words: this lesson's own vocab (words.json 'd') that the passage uses, in order of first use
format.questions: {zh, py, en, options}: asked in Chinese, with pinyin and English available; options are in English and the FIRST option is always the right answer, so shuffle before showing (same convention as lessons.json)
format.py: pinyin with dictionary tones, like words.json (no 一/不 tone-change marks), erhua written as -r, words separated by spaces

vocab_rule: Every Chinese character in a lesson's passages, titles and questions comes from that lesson's vocab or an earlier lesson's, plus 你, 中, the numbers 一 to 十 and the cast's names (王小明, 李文, 马克, 安娜). No multi-character vocab item is used before the lesson that teaches it (except 中国, 英国, 哪国人 and 分钟, whose characters are already known). tools/reading_build.py checks this on every build.

lines.zh: 我们学校附近有商店、饭店、银行和邮局。
lines.py: Wǒmen xuéxiào fùjìn yǒu shāngdiàn, fàndiàn, yínháng hé yóujú.
lines.en: Near our school there are shops, restaurants, a bank and a post office.

lines.zh: 学校前面是一条马路，马路上行人很多。
lines.py: Xuéxiào qiánmiàn shì yī tiáo mǎlù, mǎlù shàng xíngrén hěn duō.
lines.en: In front of the school is a road with lots of people walking along it.

lines.zh: 银行很近，就在学校旁边。
lines.py: Yínháng hěn jìn, jiù zài xuéxiào pángbiān.
lines.en: The bank is very close, right next to the school.

lines.zh: 邮局有点儿远，要走二十分钟。
lines.py: Yóujú yǒudiǎnr yuǎn, yào zǒu èr shí fēnzhōng.
lines.en: The post office is a bit far: it's a twenty-minute walk.

lines.zh: 学校右边有一家小饭店，菜很好吃，也很便宜。
lines.py: Xuéxiào yòubian yǒu yī jiā xiǎo fàndiàn, cài hěn hǎochī, yě hěn piányi.
lines.en: To the right of the school is a small restaurant. The food is tasty and cheap.

title.en: How do I get to the city centre?

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 小明，从这儿到市中心怎么走？
lines.py: Xiǎomíng, cóng zhèr dào shìzhōngxīn zěnme zǒu?
lines.en: Xiaoming, how do I get from here to the city centre?

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 你可以坐地铁，也可以坐公共汽车。
lines.py: Nǐ kěyǐ zuò dìtiě, yě kěyǐ zuò gōnggòng qìchē.
lines.en: You can take the subway, or you can take the bus.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 地铁站离这儿远吗？
lines.py: Dìtiě zhàn lí zhèr yuǎn ma?
lines.en: Is the subway station far from here?

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 有点儿远。公共汽车站近，就在学校门口。
lines.py: Yǒudiǎnr yuǎn. Gōnggòng qìchē zhàn jìn, jiù zài xuéxiào ménkǒu.
lines.en: It's a bit far. The bus stop is close, right at the school entrance.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 坐公共汽车要换车吗？
lines.py: Zuò gōnggòng qìchē yào huàn chē ma?
lines.en: Do I need to change buses?

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 不用换。坐十二路，在市中心下车。
lines.py: Bù yòng huàn. Zuò shí èr lù, zài shìzhōngxīn xiàchē.
lines.en: No need to change. Take the number 12 and get off in the city centre.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 要多少分钟？
lines.py: Yào duōshao fēnzhōng?
lines.en: How many minutes does it take?

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 大概二十分钟。你也可以骑自行车。
lines.py: Dàgài èr shí fēnzhōng. Nǐ yě kěyǐ qí zìxíngchē.
lines.en: About twenty minutes. You could also ride a bike.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 我没有自行车！
lines.py: Wǒ méiyǒu zìxíngchē!
lines.en: I don't have a bike!

title.en: How Li Wen gets to work

lines.zh: 李文家离公司很远。
lines.py: Lǐ Wén jiā lí gōngsī hěn yuǎn.
lines.en: Li Wen's home is a long way from her company.

lines.zh: 她每天早上骑自行车到地铁站，然后坐地铁。
lines.py: Tā měi tiān zǎoshang qí zìxíngchē dào dìtiě zhàn, ránhòu zuò dìtiě.
lines.en: Every morning she rides her bike to the subway station and then takes the subway.

lines.zh: 到了市中心，她下车，换公共汽车。
lines.py: Dào le shìzhōngxīn, tā xiàchē, huàn gōnggòng qìchē.
lines.en: When she reaches the city centre she gets off and changes to a bus.

lines.zh: 公共汽车站就在地铁站外面。
lines.py: Gōnggòng qìchē zhàn jiù zài dìtiě zhàn wàimiàn.
lines.en: The bus stop is just outside the subway station.

lines.zh: 公司在公共汽车站左边。
lines.py: Gōngsī zài gōnggòng qìchē zhàn zuǒbian.
lines.en: The company is to the left of the bus stop.

lines.zh: 从家到公司，大概要一个半钟头。
lines.py: Cóng jiā dào gōngsī, dàgài yào yī gè bàn zhōngtóu.
lines.en: From home to the company takes about an hour and a half.

lines.zh: 她说：“很远，可是没关系，在地铁上我可以看书。”
lines.py: Tā shuō: “Hěn yuǎn, kěshì méiguānxi, zài dìtiě shàng wǒ kěyǐ kàn shū.”
lines.en: She says, “It's far, but it doesn't matter. I can read on the subway.”

lines.en: Xiaoming, I hear you've got a cat?

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 是的，我很喜欢猫。你呢？你养过动物吗？
lines.py: Shìde, wǒ hěn xǐhuan māo. Nǐ ne? Nǐ yǎng guo dòngwù ma?
lines.en: That's right, I love cats. What about you? Have you ever kept animals?

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 养过。我家在英国有两只狗。
lines.py: Yǎng guo. Wǒ jiā zài Yīngguó yǒu liǎng zhī gǒu.
lines.en: Yes. My family in England has two dogs.

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 狗很可爱，但是很麻烦。
lines.py: Gǒu hěn kě'ài, dànshì hěn máfan.
lines.en: Dogs are cute, but they're a lot of trouble.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 有的狗很麻烦，我的狗不麻烦！
lines.py: Yǒude gǒu hěn máfan, wǒ de gǒu bù máfan!
lines.en: Some dogs are trouble. Mine aren't!

lines.py: Wǒ jiā pángbiān yǒu yī wèi lǎorénjiā, tā qī shí bā suì le.

lines.zh: 他自己一个人在家，养了很多花儿，还养了两只鸟。

lines.zh: 小明，下个月我要去北京。
lines.py: Xiǎomíng, xià gè yuè wǒ yào qù Běijīng.

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 太好了！北京你熟悉吗？
lines.py: Tài hǎo le! Běijīng nǐ shúxī ma?
lines.en: Great! Do you know Beijing well?

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 不熟悉。你能陪我去吗？
lines.py: Bù shúxī. Nǐ néng péi wǒ qù ma?
lines.en: No. Could you come with me?

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 要是我有时间的话，我陪你去。
lines.py: Yàoshì wǒ yǒu shíjiān dehuà, wǒ péi nǐ qù.
lines.en: If I have time, I'll go with you.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 我想去登长城。
lines.py: Wǒ xiǎng qù dēng Chángchéng.
lines.en: I'd like to climb the Great Wall.

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 长城你非去不可！我可以给你拍照。
lines.py: Chángchéng nǐ fēi qù bùkě! Wǒ kěyǐ gěi nǐ pāizhào.
lines.en: You absolutely have to go to the Great Wall! I can take photos of you.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 飞机票呢？
lines.py: Fēijīpiào ne?
lines.en: What about plane tickets?

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 我们得买飞机票。我来办吧。
lines.py: Wǒmen děi mǎi fēijīpiào. Wǒ lái bàn ba.
lines.en: We need to buy plane tickets. I'll sort them out.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 谢谢你！
lines.py: Xièxie nǐ!
lines.en: Thank you!

lines.zh: 所以马克很想再去中国。

passages.text: 王小明住在学校的宿舍。今天早上他不舒服，没去上课。大家都很担心。同学们说：“他可能病了，我们去看看他吧。”他们到宿舍的时候，王小明正在睡觉。下午他已经好多了，还去餐厅吃了饭。

lines.speaker: 医生
lines.zh: 你怎么了？
lines.py: Nǐ zěnme le?
lines.en: What's the matter?

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 医生，我肚子疼。
lines.py: Yīshēng, wǒ dùzi téng.
lines.en: Doctor, I've got a stomach ache.

lines.speaker: 医生
lines.zh: 你昨天吃了什么？

lines.speaker: 马克

lines.en: A friend treated us, and we had sashimi.

lines.speaker: 医生
lines.zh: 生鱼片新鲜吗？
lines.py: Shēngyúpiàn xīnxiān ma?
lines.en: Was the sashimi fresh?

lines.speaker: 马克

lines.py: Wǒ bù zhīdào. Wǒ hái hē le liǎng bēi niúnǎi.
lines.en: I don't know. I also drank two glasses of milk.

lines.speaker: 医生
lines.zh: 别着急，不是大病。吃一点儿药就好了。
lines.py: Bié zháojí, bù shì dà bìng. Chī yīdiǎnr yào jiù hǎo le.
lines.en: Don't worry, it's nothing serious. Take some medicine and you'll be fine.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 我能吃东西吗？
lines.py: Wǒ néng chī dōngxi ma?
lines.en: Can I eat?

lines.speaker: 医生
lines.zh: 今天只能吃一点儿面包，别喝牛奶。
lines.py: Jīntiān zhǐ néng chī yīdiǎnr miànbāo, bié hē niúnǎi.
lines.en: Today you can only have a little bread. Don't drink milk.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 谢谢医生！
lines.py: Xièxie yīshēng!
lines.en: Thank you, doctor!

lines.en: Great! We'll go to the museum first, then go and eat.

passages.text: 小明，你的家乡在哪儿？在北京。北京的冬天冷吗？很冷，温度是零下十度左右。零下十度！太冷了！可是房间里有暖气，很暖和。你的家乡呢？我的家乡在英国，冬天没有北京冷，大概五度左右。夏天呢？夏天很凉快，不太热。北京的夏天比你的家乡热多了！

lines.zh: 今天早上我听了天气预报。
lines.py: Jīntiān zǎoshang wǒ tīng le tiānqì yùbào.
lines.en: This morning I listened to the weather forecast.

lines.zh: 天气预报说今天很热，温度是三十五度。
lines.py: Tiānqì yùbào shuō jīntiān hěn rè, wēndù shì sān shí wǔ dù.
lines.en: The forecast said today will be hot, with a temperature of 35 degrees.

lines.zh: 明天比今天更热，三十八度！
lines.py: Míngtiān bǐ jīntiān gèng rè, sān shí bā dù!
lines.en: Tomorrow will be even hotter than today: 38 degrees!

lines.zh: 我不喜欢夏天，我喜欢凉快的天气。

lines.en: I don't like summer. I like cool weather.

lines.zh: 下午我在家里看电视，不出去。

lines.en: In the afternoon I'm watching TV at home, not going out.

lines.zh: 晚上温度低一点儿，我跟朋友出去吃饭。
lines.py: Wǎnshang wēndù dī yīdiǎnr, wǒ gēn péngyou chūqù chī fàn.
lines.en: In the evening it's a bit cooler, so I'm going out to eat with friends.

lines.zh: 我最喜欢秋天。秋天的枫叶美丽极了！
lines.py: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan qiūtiān. Qiūtiān de fēngyè měilì jíle!
lines.en: I like autumn best. The maple leaves in autumn are gorgeous!

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 我最喜欢夏天，因为我喜欢游泳。
lines.py: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan xiàtiān, yīnwèi wǒ xǐhuan yóuyǒng.

lines.en: In winter I often go skiing.

lines.py: Yīngguó de dōngtiān chángcháng xiàyǔ, yǒudeshíhou guāfēng, xuě bù duō.
lines.en: Winters in England are often rainy and sometimes windy, but there isn't much snow.

lines.py: Chūntiān ne?
lines.en: And spring?

lines.zh: 星期五的天气跟星期一一样，是晴天。
lines.py: Xīngqī wǔ de tiānqì gēn xīngqī yī yīyàng, shì qíngtiān.
lines.en: Friday's weather was the same as Monday's: sunny.

lines.zh: 我们这里的天气真有意思！

lines.en: I prefer the city. It's lively, and getting around is easy.

lines.py: Kěshì chéngshì tài chǎo le! Mǎlù shàng chēshuǐmǎlóng.

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 那你喜欢农村？

lines.zh: 对。农村的空气好，环境也好。
lines.py: Duì. Nóngcūn de kōngqì hǎo, huánjìng yě hǎo.
lines.en: Right. The air in the countryside is good, and so is the environment.

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 我老家在东北的农村。那里冬天冷死了！
lines.py: Wǒ lǎojiā zài dōngběi de nóngcūn. Nàli dōngtiān lěng sǐ le!
lines.en: My family home is in the countryside in the northeast. The winters there are freezing!

passages.text: 王小明的专业是英语。他是四年级的学生，明年他想当英语老师。他每天练习口语和听力，也练习阅读和写作。他的英语说得很清楚，也很标准。他常常给外国学生介绍中国文化。外国学生都说：“小明的英语跟我们的母语一样好！”

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 马克，明天的考试难吗？
lines.py: Mǎkè, míngtiān de kǎoshì nán ma?
lines.en: Mark, is tomorrow's exam hard?

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 不太难。开始是听写，然后是谈话。
lines.py: Bùtài nán. Kāishǐ shì tīngxiě, ránhòu shì tánhuà.
lines.en: Not too hard. First there's dictation, then a conversation.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 听写容易，谈话难！
lines.py: Tīngxiě róngyì, tánhuà nán!
lines.en: Dictation is easy; the conversation is hard!

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 别担心，我们互相练习吧。
lines.py: Bié dānxīn, wǒmen hùxiāng liànxí ba.
lines.en: Don't worry, let's practise with each other.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 好，我先说，你听。我最喜欢的食品是水饺…
lines.py: Hǎo, wǒ xiān shuō, nǐ tīng. Wǒ zuì xǐhuan de shípǐn shì shuǐjiǎo…
lines.en: OK, I'll speak first and you listen. My favourite food is dumplings...

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 慢一点儿！我听得糊里糊涂。
lines.py: Màn yīdiǎnr! Wǒ tīng de húlihútu.
lines.en: Slow down! I'm completely lost.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 对不起。每个句子我说两遍，行吗？
lines.py: Duìbuqǐ. Měi gè jùzi wǒ shuō liǎng biàn, xíng ma?
lines.en: Sorry. I'll say each sentence twice, OK?

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 行！我们练习一刻钟，最后再听写。
lines.py: Xíng! Wǒmen liànxí yī kèzhōng, zuìhòu zài tīngxiě.
lines.en: OK! Let's practise for a quarter of an hour, and do dictation last.

lines.zh: 今天我们考汉语。考试十点开始。
lines.py: Jīntiān wǒmen kǎo Hànyǔ. Kǎoshì shí diǎn kāishǐ.
lines.en: Today we had our Chinese exam. It started at ten.

lines.zh: 第一部分是听写。老师说了十个句子，每个句子说两遍。
lines.py: Dì yī bùfèn shì tīngxiě. Lǎoshī shuō le shí gè jùzi, měi gè jùzi shuō liǎng biàn.
lines.en: The first part was dictation. The teacher read ten sentences, each one twice.

lines.zh: 我很努力，可是有一个字我忘了怎么写。
lines.py: Wǒ hěn nǔlì, kěshì yǒu yī gè zì wǒ wàng le zěnme xiě.
lines.en: I tried hard, but I forgot how to write one character.

lines.zh: 第二部分是谈话，老师问我喜欢什么食品。
lines.py: Dì èr bùfèn shì tánhuà, lǎoshī wèn wǒ xǐhuan shénme shípǐn.
lines.en: The second part was a conversation. The teacher asked me what food I like.

lines.zh: 最后老师说：“很好，你的汉语越来越好了！”
lines.py: Zuìhòu lǎoshī shuō: “Hěn hǎo, nǐ de Hànyǔ yuèláiyuè hǎo le!”
lines.en: At the end the teacher said, “Very good. Your Chinese is getting better and better!”

lines.speaker: 经理
lines.zh: 李文，去北京的航班推迟了。
lines.py: Lǐ Wén, qù Běijīng de hángbān tuīchí le.
lines.en: Li Wen, the flight to Beijing has been postponed.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.zh: 推迟到几点？
lines.py: Tuīchí dào jǐ diǎn?
lines.en: Postponed until when?

lines.speaker: 经理
lines.zh: 推迟到明天上午。所以我们得这样安排：
lines.py: Tuīchí dào míngtiān shàngwǔ. Suǒyǐ wǒmen děi zhèyàng ānpái:
lines.en: Until tomorrow morning. So here's how we'll arrange things:

lines.speaker: 经理
lines.zh: 你马上给北京公司发一个传真，告诉他们我们明天下午到。
lines.py: Nǐ mǎshàng gěi Běijīng gōngsī fā yī gè chuánzhēn, gàosu tāmen wǒmen míngtiān xiàwǔ dào.
lines.en: Send a fax to the Beijing company right away and tell them we'll arrive tomorrow afternoon.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.zh: 好。明天的贸易活动呢？
lines.py: Hǎo. Míngtiān de màoyì huódòng ne?
lines.en: OK. What about tomorrow's trade event?

lines.speaker: 经理
lines.zh: 你先去参加，我下午到。
lines.py: Nǐ xiān qù cānjiā, wǒ xiàwǔ dào.
lines.en: You go first, and I'll get there in the afternoon.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.zh: 金融公司的领导也要见您。
lines.py: Jīnróng gōngsī de lǐngdǎo yě yào jiàn nín.
lines.en: The head of the finance company also wants to meet you.

lines.speaker: 经理
lines.zh: 那就安排在后天上午吧。
lines.py: Nà jiù ānpái zài hòutiān shàngwǔ ba.
lines.en: Then arrange it for the morning of the day after tomorrow.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.zh: 好的，我马上打一通电话。
lines.py: Hǎo de, wǒ mǎshàng dǎ yī tōng diànhuà.
lines.en: Fine, I'll make a call right away.

questions.en: What happened to the flight to Beijing?

questions.py: Jīnglǐ ràng Lǐ Wén mǎshàng gàn shénme?

lines.zh: 李文在一家外贸公司工作。
lines.py: Lǐ Wén zài yī jiā wàimào gōngsī gōngzuò.
lines.en: Li Wen works at a foreign trade company.

lines.zh: 她的经理是一位很好的领导。
lines.py: Tā de jīnglǐ shì yī wèi hěn hǎo de lǐngdǎo.
lines.en: Her manager is a very good boss.

lines.zh: 公司做中国和美国的贸易，所以李文常常用英语。
lines.py: Gōngsī zuò Zhōngguó hé Měiguó de màoyì, suǒyǐ Lǐ Wén chángcháng yòng Yīngyǔ.
lines.en: The company trades between China and America, so Li Wen often uses English.

lines.zh: 她每天要打很多通电话，还要发传真和电子邮件。
lines.py: Tā měi tiān yào dǎ hěn duō tōng diànhuà, hái yào fā chuánzhēn hé diànzǐ yóujiàn.
lines.en: Every day she has to make lots of phone calls and send faxes and emails.

lines.zh: 下个星期她要去上海参加一个金融市场的活动。
lines.py: Xià gè xīngqī tā yào qù Shànghǎi cānjiā yī gè jīnróng shìchǎng de huódòng.
lines.en: Next week she's going to Shanghai for a financial markets event.

lines.zh: 经理说：“那里有很多大公司，你一定要去。”
lines.py: Jīnglǐ shuō: “Nàli yǒu hěn duō dà gōngsī, nǐ yīdìng yào qù.”
lines.en: Her manager says, “There'll be lots of big companies there. You must go.”

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 小明，你的手怎么回事？
lines.py: Xiǎomíng, nǐ de shǒu zěnme huí shì?
lines.en: Xiaoming, what happened to your hand?

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 昨天早上我骑自行车去上课，发生了一个小事故。
lines.py: Zuótiān zǎoshang wǒ qí zìxíngchē qù shàngkè, fāshēng le yī gè xiǎo shìgù.
lines.en: Yesterday morning I was riding my bike to class and had a little accident.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 什么事故？
lines.py: Shénme shìgù?
lines.en: What kind of accident?

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 下着雨，我拿着雨伞骑车，结果撞了一个行人。
lines.py: Xià zhe yǔ, wǒ ná zhe yǔsǎn qí chē, jiéguǒ zhuàng le yī gè xíngrén.
lines.en: It was raining, and I was riding along holding an umbrella. I ended up hitting a pedestrian.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 那个人没事儿吧？
lines.py: Nàge rén méi shìr ba?
lines.en: Was that person all right?

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 他没事儿，倒是我摔了，手破了。
lines.py: Tā méi shìr, dào shì wǒ shuāi le, shǒu pò le.
lines.en: He was fine. It was me who fell and scraped my hand.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 你去医院检查了吗？
lines.py: Nǐ qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá le ma?
lines.en: Did you go to the hospital for a check-up?

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 去了。医生说身体没问题，可是我的自行车坏了。
lines.py: Qù le. Yīshēng shuō shēntǐ méi wèntí, kěshì wǒ de zìxíngchē huài le.
lines.en: I did. The doctor said I'm fine, but my bike is broken.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 下雨的时候别骑车了，穿雨衣走路吧！
lines.py: Xiàyǔ de shíhou bié qí chē le, chuān yǔyī zǒu lù ba!
lines.en: When it rains, don't ride your bike. Put on a raincoat and walk!

questions.en: What happened to Wang Xiaoming's hand?
options: He scraped it when he fell

passages.text: 小明，你的手怎么回事？昨天早上我骑自行车去上课，发生了一个小事故。什么事故？下着雨，我拿着雨伞骑车，结果撞了一个行人。那个人没事儿吧？他没事儿，倒是我摔了，手破了。你去医院检查了吗？去了。医生说身体没问题，可是我的自行车坏了。下雨的时候别骑车了，穿雨衣走路吧！

lines.zh: 今天早上，李文开车去上班。
lines.py: Jīntiān zǎoshang, Lǐ Wén kāichē qù shàngbān.
lines.en: This morning Li Wen drove to work.

lines.zh: 在路上发生了一个事故：一个骑自行车的人撞了一个行人。
lines.py: Zài lùshàng fāshēng le yī gè shìgù: yī gè qí zìxíngchē de rén zhuàng le yī gè xíngrén.
lines.en: There was an accident on the way: a cyclist hit a pedestrian.

lines.zh: 行人摔倒了，身体没有伤，可是他的雨伞破了。
lines.py: Xíngrén shuāi dǎo le, shēntǐ méiyǒu shāng, kěshì tā de yǔsǎn pò le.
lines.en: The pedestrian fell over. He wasn't hurt, but his umbrella was ruined.

lines.zh: 警察马上来了，他问：“怎么回事？”
lines.py: Jǐngchá mǎshàng lái le, tā wèn: “Zěnme huí shì?”
lines.en: The police came straight away and asked, “What's going on?”

lines.zh: 骑车的人说：“下雨，我没看清楚。”
lines.py: Qí chē de rén shuō: “Xiàyǔ, wǒ méi kàn qīngchu.”
lines.en: The cyclist said, “It was raining, and I couldn't see clearly.”

lines.zh: 结果，李文上班晚了一刻钟。
lines.py: Jiéguǒ, Lǐ Wén shàngbān wǎn le yī kèzhōng.
lines.en: As a result, Li Wen was a quarter of an hour late for work.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 您好，听说您有房子出租？
lines.py: Nín hǎo, tīngshuō nín yǒu fángzi chūzū?
lines.en: Hello, I hear you have a flat to rent?

lines.speaker: 房东
lines.zh: 对，是一套两个房间的房子，在八楼。
lines.py: Duì, shì yī tào liǎng gè fángjiān de fángzi, zài bā lóu.
lines.en: That's right. It's a two-room flat on the eighth floor.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 有电梯吗？
lines.py: Yǒu diàntī ma?
lines.en: Is there a lift?

lines.speaker: 房东
lines.zh: 没有。
lines.py: Méiyǒu.
lines.en: No.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 八楼没有电梯？太累了！
lines.py: Bā lóu méiyǒu diàntī? Tài lèi le!
lines.en: The eighth floor with no lift? That's exhausting!

lines.speaker: 房东
lines.zh: 没关系，你就当锻炼身体吧！
lines.py: Méiguānxi, nǐ jiù dāng duànliàn shēntǐ ba!
lines.en: Never mind, think of it as exercise!

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 有空调和洗衣机吗？
lines.py: Yǒu kōngtiáo hé xǐyījī ma?
lines.en: Is there air conditioning and a washing machine?

lines.speaker: 房东
lines.zh: 都有，还有电视机。
lines.py: Dōu yǒu, hái yǒu diànshìjī.
lines.en: Both, and a TV as well.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 一个月多少钱？
lines.py: Yī gè yuè duōshao qián?
lines.en: How much is it a month?

lines.speaker: 房东
lines.zh: 两千块。如果你要租，得先付一个月的押金。
lines.py: Liǎng qiān kuài. Rúguǒ nǐ yào zū, děi xiān fù yī gè yuè de yājīn.
lines.en: Two thousand kuai. If you want to rent it, you have to pay a month's deposit first.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 好，明天我带押金来办合同。
lines.py: Hǎo, míngtiān wǒ dài yājīn lái bàn hétong.
lines.en: OK, I'll bring the deposit tomorrow and sort out the contract.

lines.zh: 那台洗衣机太旧了。我明天让师傅来看看。
lines.py: Nà tái xǐyījī tài jiù le. Wǒ míngtiān ràng shīfu lái kàn kàn.
lines.en: That washing machine is too old. I'll have a repairman look at it tomorrow.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 明天？我的衣服都在里面！
lines.py: Míngtiān? Wǒ de yīfu dōu zài lǐmiàn!
lines.en: Tomorrow? All my clothes are inside it!

lines.speaker: 房东
lines.zh: 对不起，今天师傅很忙，没有办法。
lines.py: Duìbuqǐ, jīntiān shīfu hěn máng, méiyǒu bànfǎ.
lines.en: Sorry, the repairman is busy today. There's nothing I can do.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 真不像话！
lines.py: Zhēn bùxiànghuà!
lines.en: This is ridiculous!

lines.speaker: 房东
lines.zh: 别生气。我买一台新的，电器商店明天送来。
lines.py: Bié shēngqì. Wǒ mǎi yī tái xīn de, diànqì shāngdiàn míngtiān sòng lái.
lines.en: Don't be angry. I'll buy a new one, and the electrical shop will deliver it tomorrow.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 好吧，那我只好等到明天了。
lines.py: Hǎo ba, nà wǒ zhǐhǎo děng dào míngtiān le.
lines.en: Fine, then I'll just have to wait until tomorrow.

passages.text: 王先生，公寓的洗衣机坏了。怎么回事？我一开就坏了。那台洗衣机太旧了。我明天让师傅来看看。明天？我的衣服都在里面！对不起，今天师傅很忙，没有办法。真不像话！别生气。我买一台新的，电器商店明天送来。好吧，那我只好等到明天了。

lines.zh: 我租了一套新公寓。
lines.py: Wǒ zū le yī tào xīn gōngyù.
lines.en: I've rented a new flat.

lines.zh: 公寓不大，有一个房间、一个厨房和一个卫生间。
lines.py: Gōngyù bù dà, yǒu yī gè fángjiān, yī gè chúfáng hé yī gè wèishēngjiān.
lines.en: It isn't big: one room, a kitchen and a bathroom.

lines.zh: 厨房很旧，不过很干净。
lines.py: Chúfáng hěn jiù, bùguò hěn gānjìng.
lines.en: The kitchen is old, but it's clean.

lines.zh: 房东给我装了一台新空调。
lines.py: Fángdōng gěi wǒ zhuāng le yī tái xīn kōngtiáo.
lines.en: The landlord installed a new air conditioner for me.

lines.zh: 可是公寓里没有电视机，我只好自己买。
lines.py: Kěshì gōngyù lǐ méiyǒu diànshìjī, wǒ zhǐhǎo zìjǐ mǎi.
lines.en: But there's no TV in the flat, so I had to buy one myself.

lines.zh: 电器商店送来了电视机，一位师傅帮我装好了。
lines.py: Diànqì shāngdiàn sòng lái le diànshìjī, yī wèi shīfu bāng wǒ zhuāng hǎo le.
lines.en: The electrical shop delivered the TV, and a technician set it up for me.

What is the kitchen like?

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 小明，今天晚上的京剧几点开始？
lines.py: Xiǎomíng, jīntiān wǎnshang de Jīngjù jǐ diǎn kāishǐ?
lines.en: Xiaoming, what time does tonight's opera start?

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 七点半。现在六点四十，我们最好马上出发。
lines.py: Qī diǎn bàn. Xiànzài liù diǎn sì shí, wǒmen zuìhǎo mǎshàng chūfā.
lines.en: Seven thirty. It's six forty now, so we'd better set off right away.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 我们坐地铁还是坐出租车？
lines.py: Wǒmen zuò dìtiě háishi zuò chūzūchē?
lines.en: Shall we take the subway or a taxi?

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 现在路上堵车，坐地铁吧。
lines.py: Xiànzài lùshàng dǔchē, zuò dìtiě ba.
lines.en: The roads are jammed right now. Let's take the subway.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 我们能赶上吗？
lines.py: Wǒmen néng gǎnshàng ma?
lines.en: Will we make it in time?

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 放心，能赶上。我们的座位很好，在前面。
lines.py: Fàngxīn, néng gǎnshàng. Wǒmen de zuòwèi hěn hǎo, zài qiánmiàn.
lines.en: Don't worry, we'll make it. Our seats are good, near the front.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 这场京剧有名吗？
lines.py: Zhè chǎng Jīngjù yǒumíng ma?
lines.en: Is this opera famous?

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 挺有名的，报纸上说那个演员特别好。
lines.py: Tǐng yǒumíng de, bàozhǐ shàng shuō nàge yǎnyuán tèbié hǎo.
lines.en: Quite famous. The newspaper says the lead actor is especially good.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 我听不懂京剧，不过我喜欢武打戏。
lines.py: Wǒ tīngbùdǒng Jīngjù, bùguò wǒ xǐhuan wǔdǎxì.
lines.en: I can't understand Beijing opera, but I like martial-arts plays.

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 没关系，你用眼睛看就行了！
lines.py: Méiguānxi, nǐ yòng yǎnjing kàn jiù xíng le!
lines.en: That's fine, you can just watch with your eyes!

questions.zh: 他们为什么不坐出租车？
questions.en: Why don't they take a taxi?
Where are their seats?

questions.zh: 王小明说马克可以怎么看京剧？
questions.py: Wáng Xiǎomíng shuō Mǎkè kěyǐ zěnme kàn Jīngjù?
questions.en: How does Xiaoming say Mark can enjoy the opera?

passages.text: 小明，今天晚上的京剧几点开始？七点半。现在六点四十，我们最好马上出发。我们坐地铁还是坐出租车？现在路上堵车，坐地铁吧。我们能赶上吗？放心，能赶上。我们的座位很好，在前面。这场京剧有名吗？挺有名的，报纸上说那个演员特别好。我听不懂京剧，不过我喜欢武打戏。没关系，你用眼睛看就行了！

lines.zh: 李文每天早上看报纸。
lines.py: Lǐ Wén měi tiān zǎoshang kàn bàozhǐ.
lines.en: Li Wen reads the newspaper every morning.

lines.zh: 今天报纸上有一个有名的京剧演员。
lines.py: Jīntiān bàozhǐ shàng yǒu yī gè yǒumíng de Jīngjù yǎnyuán.
lines.en: Today there's a famous Beijing opera actor in the paper.

lines.zh: 他十岁开始学京剧，武打戏演得特别好。
lines.py: Tā shí suì kāishǐ xué Jīngjù, wǔdǎxì yǎn de tèbié hǎo.
lines.en: He started learning Beijing opera at ten, and he's especially good at martial-arts plays.

lines.zh: 李文的爸爸挺喜欢京剧，他说：“这个演员我一定要看！”
lines.py: Lǐ Wén de bàba tǐng xǐhuan Jīngjù, tā shuō: “Zhège yǎnyuán wǒ yīdìng yào kàn!”
lines.en: Li Wen's dad really likes Beijing opera. He said, “I must see this actor!”

lines.zh: 所以李文买了两张票，星期六陪爸爸去看。
lines.py: Suǒyǐ Lǐ Wén mǎi le liǎng zhāng piào, xīngqīliù péi bàba qù kàn.
lines.en: So Li Wen bought two tickets and is taking her dad on Saturday.

questions.py: Lǐ Wén měi tiān zǎoshang kàn shénme?
questions.en: What does Li Wen read every morning?

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 马克，你平时运动吗？
lines.py: Mǎkè, nǐ píngshí yùndòng ma?
lines.en: Mark, do you usually exercise?

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 不运动，我太懒了。
lines.py: Bù yùndòng, wǒ tài lǎn le.
lines.en: No, I'm too lazy.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 医生建议大家每天运动。明天早上我们一起去跑步吧！
lines.py: Yīshēng jiànyì dàjiā měi tiān yùndòng. Míngtiān zǎoshang wǒmen yīqǐ qù pǎobù ba!
lines.en: Doctors suggest everyone should exercise every day. Let's go running together tomorrow morning!

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 几点？
lines.py: Jǐ diǎn?
lines.en: What time?

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 六点。
lines.py: Liù diǎn.
lines.en: Six o'clock.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 六点？我连七点都起不来！
lines.py: Liù diǎn? Wǒ lián qī diǎn dōu qǐ bù lái!
lines.en: Six? I can't even get up at seven!

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 那我们下午去爬山吧，山顶很安静。
lines.py: Nà wǒmen xiàwǔ qù pá shān ba, shāndǐng hěn ānjìng.
lines.en: Then let's climb the hill in the afternoon. It's very peaceful at the top.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 好，我带水。
lines.py: Hǎo, wǒ dài shuǐ.
lines.en: OK, I'll bring water.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 我爸爸会打太极拳，他可以教我们。
lines.py: Wǒ bàba huì dǎ tàijíquán, tā kěyǐ jiāo wǒmen.
lines.en: My dad can do tai chi. He can teach us.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 太好了！
lines.py: Tài hǎo le!
lines.en: Great!

questions.en: Does Mark usually exercise?

questions.zh: 安娜先建议明天早上干什么？
questions.py: Ānnà xiān jiànyì míngtiān zǎoshang gàn shénme?
questions.en: What does Anna first suggest doing tomorrow morning?

questions.zh: 马克为什么不想六点跑步？
questions.py: Mǎkè wèishénme bù xiǎng liù diǎn pǎobù?
questions.en: Why doesn't Mark want to run at six?
options: He can't even get up at seven

questions.en: Who can do tai chi?

passages.text: 马克，你平时运动吗？不运动，我太懒了。医生建议大家每天运动。明天早上我们一起去跑步吧！几点？六点。六点？我连七点都起不来！那我们下午去爬山吧，山顶很安静。好，我带水。我爸爸会打太极拳，他可以教我们。太好了！

lines.zh: 星期天早上，我们去爬山。
lines.py: Xīngqī tiān zǎoshang, wǒmen qù pá shān.
lines.en: On Sunday morning we went climbing.

lines.zh: 山很高，我们慢慢地爬。
lines.py: Shān hěn gāo, wǒmen màn màn de pá.
lines.en: The hill was high, so we climbed slowly.

lines.zh: 马克跑得很快，一个小时就到了山顶。
lines.py: Mǎkè pǎo de hěn kuài, yī gè xiǎoshí jiù dào le shāndǐng.
lines.en: Mark ran very fast and reached the top in just an hour.

lines.zh: 我十一点才到。
lines.py: Wǒ shíyīdiǎn cái dào.
lines.en: I didn't get there until eleven.

lines.zh: 山顶非常安静，我们坐下来休息。
lines.py: Shāndǐng fēicháng ānjìng, wǒmen zuò xià lái xiūxi.
lines.en: It was very quiet at the top, and we sat down to rest.

lines.zh: 我说：“运动真好，我们下个星期再来吧！”
lines.py: Wǒ shuō: “Yùndòng zhēn hǎo, wǒmen xià gè xīngqī zài lái ba!”
lines.en: I said, “Exercise is great. Let's come again next week!”

questions.en: What did they do on Sunday?

questions.zh: 马克用了多长时间到山顶？
questions.py: Mǎkè yòng le duō cháng shíjiān dào shāndǐng?
questions.en: How long did Mark take to reach the top?
When did the narrator reach the top?
What was the top like?

passages.text: 星期天早上，我们去爬山。山很高，我们慢慢地爬。马克跑得很快，一个小时就到了山顶。我十一点才到。山顶非常安静，我们坐下来休息。我说：“运动真好，我们下个星期再来吧！”

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 糟糕！我的发票呢？
lines.py: Zāogāo! Wǒ de fāpiào ne?
lines.en: Oh no! Where's my receipt?

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 什么发票？
lines.py: Shénme fāpiào?
lines.en: What receipt?

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 刚才出租车司机给我的发票。我记得我把发票放在钱包里了。
lines.py: Gāngcái chūzūchē sījī gěi wǒ de fāpiào. Wǒ jìde wǒ bǎ fāpiào fàng zài qiánbāo lǐ le.
lines.en: The one the taxi driver gave me just now. I remember putting it in my wallet.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 你看看钱包。
lines.py: Nǐ kàn kàn qiánbāo.
lines.en: Have a look in your wallet.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 没有。我是不是把发票扔进垃圾箱了？
lines.py: Méiyǒu. Wǒ shìbùshì bǎ fāpiào rēng jìn lājīxiāng le?
lines.en: It's not there. Did I throw it in the bin?

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 发票有用吗？
lines.py: Fāpiào yǒuyòng ma?
lines.en: Does the receipt matter?

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 有用！公司要发票。
lines.py: Yǒuyòng! Gōngsī yào fāpiào.
lines.en: Yes! My company needs it.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 那我们赶快去看看垃圾箱吧！
lines.py: Nà wǒmen gǎnkuài qù kàn kàn lājīxiāng ba!
lines.en: Then let's hurry and check the bin!

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 找到了！在垃圾里。
lines.py: Zhǎo dào le! Zài lājī lǐ.
lines.en: Found it! It was in the rubbish.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 下次别把有用的东西扔了！
lines.py: Xià cì bié bǎ yǒuyòng de dōngxi rēng le!
lines.en: Next time, don't throw away useful things!

questions.en: What did Mark lose?

Why does Mark need the receipt?
Where was the receipt in the end?

lines.zh: 李文的爸爸什么东西都不扔。
lines.py: Lǐ Wén de bàba shénme dōngxi dōu bù rēng.
lines.en: Li Wen's dad never throws anything away.

lines.zh: 旧报纸、旧衣服、旧电器，他都放在地下室里。
lines.py: Jiù bàozhǐ, jiù yīfu, jiù diànqì, tā dōu fàng zài dìxiàshì lǐ.
lines.en: Old newspapers, old clothes, old appliances: he keeps them all in the basement.

lines.zh: 李文觉得这些东西都没用，想把这些东西都扔了。
lines.py: Lǐ Wén juéde zhè xiē dōngxi dōu méiyòng, xiǎng bǎ zhè xiē dōngxi dōu rēng le.
lines.en: Li Wen thinks all this stuff is useless and wants to throw it all out.

lines.zh: 爸爸说：“别扔！有用！”
lines.py: Bàba shuō: “Bié rēng! Yǒuyòng!”
lines.en: Her dad says, “Don't throw it away! It's useful!”

lines.zh: 昨天，爸爸在旧衣服里找到了一个钱包，里面有一百美元！
lines.py: Zuótiān, bàba zài jiù yīfu lǐ zhǎo dào le yī gè qiánbāo, lǐmiàn yǒu yī bǎi Měiyuán!
lines.en: Yesterday, her dad found a wallet among the old clothes with a hundred US dollars in it!

lines.zh: 爸爸说：“你看，我说有用吧！”
lines.py: Bàba shuō: “Nǐ kàn, wǒ shuō yǒuyòng ba!”
lines.en: Her dad said, “See, I told you it was useful!”

questions.zh: 李文的爸爸把旧东西放在哪儿？
questions.py: Lǐ Wén de bàba bǎ jiù dōngxi fàng zài nǎr?
questions.en: Where does Li Wen's dad keep old things?

questions.zh: 李文觉得这些东西怎么样？
questions.py: Lǐ Wén juéde zhè xiē dōngxi zěnmeyàng?
questions.en: What does Li Wen think of these things?

questions.zh: 爸爸在旧衣服里找到了什么？
questions.py: Bàba zài jiù yīfu lǐ zhǎo dào le shénme?
questions.en: What did her dad find among the old clothes?

questions.zh: 爸爸说那些东西怎么样？

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 您好，我的护照丢了！
lines.py: Nín hǎo, wǒ de hùzhào diū le!
lines.en: Hello, I've lost my passport!

lines.speaker: 小姐
lines.zh: 别着急。您什么时候发现护照丢了？
lines.py: Bié zháojí. Nín shénme shíhou fāxiàn hùzhào diū le?
lines.en: Don't worry. When did you notice it was missing?

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 刚才在出租车上。我把护照放在口袋里，现在没有了。
lines.py: Gāngcái zài chūzūchē shàng. Wǒ bǎ hùzhào fàng zài kǒudài lǐ, xiànzài méiyǒu le.
lines.en: Just now in the taxi. I put my passport in my pocket, and now it's gone.

lines.speaker: 小姐
lines.zh: 您其他的证件呢？
lines.py: Nín qítā de zhèngjiàn ne?
lines.en: What about your other ID?

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 其他的都在。
lines.py: Qítā de dōu zài.
lines.en: Everything else is here.

lines.speaker: 小姐
lines.zh: 您记得是哪家出租车公司吗？
lines.py: Nín jìde shì nǎ jiā chūzūchē gōngsī ma?
lines.en: Do you remember which taxi company it was?

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 我有发票。
lines.py: Wǒ yǒu fāpiào.
lines.en: I have the receipt.

lines.speaker: 小姐
lines.zh: 好，我给出租车公司打电话。
lines.py: Hǎo, wǒ gěi chūzūchē gōngsī dǎ diànhuà.
lines.en: Good, I'll phone the taxi company.

lines.speaker: 小姐
lines.zh: 他们说一位乘客在车上发现了一本护照，司机马上送来。
lines.py: Tāmen shuō yī wèi chéngkè zài chē shàng fāxiàn le yī běn hùzhào, sījī mǎshàng sòng lái.
lines.en: They say a passenger found a passport in the taxi, and the driver will bring it straight over.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 太好了！那位乘客真诚实，我要感谢他。
lines.py: Tài hǎo le! Nà wèi chéngkè zhēn chéngshí, wǒ yào gǎnxiè tā.
lines.en: Wonderful! That passenger is really honest. I want to thank him.

questions.en: What did Anna lose?

questions.zh: 安娜把护照放在哪儿了？
questions.py: Ānnà bǎ hùzhào fàng zài nǎr le?
questions.en: Where had Anna put her passport?
Who found the passport?

questions.zh: 安娜说那位乘客怎么样？
questions.py: Ānnà shuō nà wèi chéngkè zěnmeyàng?
questions.en: What does Anna say about the passenger?

passages.text: 您好，我的护照丢了！别着急。您什么时候发现护照丢了？刚才在出租车上。我把护照放在口袋里，现在没有了。您其他的证件呢？其他的都在。您记得是哪家出租车公司吗？我有发票。好，我给出租车公司打电话。他们说一位乘客在车上发现了一本护照，司机马上送来。太好了！那位乘客真诚实，我要感谢他。

lines.zh: 王先生是一位出租车司机。
lines.py: Wáng xiānsheng shì yī wèi chūzūchē sījī.
lines.en: Mr Wang is a taxi driver.

lines.zh: 昨天晚上，他在座位上发现了一个钱包。
lines.py: Zuótiān wǎnshang, tā zài zuòwèi shàng fāxiàn le yī gè qiánbāo.
lines.en: Last night he found a wallet on a seat.

lines.zh: 钱包里有很多钱和一些证件，还有一张纸，上面写着一个宾馆的地址。
lines.py: Qiánbāo lǐ yǒu hěn duō qián hé yī xiē zhèngjiàn, hái yǒu yī zhāng zhǐ, shàngmiàn xiě zhe yī gè bīnguǎn de dìzhǐ.
lines.en: In it were lots of money, some ID, and a piece of paper with a hotel's address written on it.

lines.zh: 王先生把钱包交给了宾馆总台，总台把钱包转给了那位乘客。
lines.py: Wáng xiānsheng bǎ qiánbāo jiāo gěi le bīnguǎn zǒngtái, zǒngtái bǎ qiánbāo zhuǎn gěi le nà wèi chéngkè.
lines.en: Mr Wang handed the wallet in at the hotel's front desk, and the desk passed it on to the passenger.

lines.zh: 乘客非常感谢他，要给他钱，王先生不要。
lines.py: Chéngkè fēicháng gǎnxiè tā, yào gěi tā qián, Wáng xiānsheng bù yào.
lines.en: The passenger thanked him warmly and wanted to give him money, but Mr Wang wouldn't take it.

lines.zh: 他说：“小时候我拿了别人的东西，爸爸骂了我一顿。我记住了：要诚实。”
lines.py: Tā shuō: “Xiǎoshíhou wǒ ná le biéren de dōngxi, bàba mà le wǒ yī dùn. Wǒ jìzhu le: yào chéngshí.”
lines.en: He said, “When I was little I took something that belonged to someone else, and my dad gave me a good telling-off. I've remembered it: be honest.”

questions.zh: 王先生在哪儿发现了钱包？
questions.py: Wáng xiānsheng zài nǎr fāxiàn le qiánbāo?
questions.en: Where did Mr Wang find the wallet?
options: On a seat in his taxi

questions.en: What was in the wallet?
options: Money, ID and a hotel address

questions.zh: 王先生把钱包交给了谁？
questions.py: Wáng xiānsheng bǎ qiánbāo jiāo gěi le shéi?
questions.en: Who did Mr Wang hand the wallet to?

questions.py: Wáng xiānsheng yào chéngkè de qián ma?
questions.en: Did Mr Wang accept the passenger's money?

passages.text: 王先生是一位出租车司机。昨天晚上，他在座位上发现了一个钱包。钱包里有很多钱和一些证件，还有一张纸，上面写着一个宾馆的地址。王先生把钱包交给了宾馆总台，总台把钱包转给了那位乘客。乘客非常感谢他，要给他钱，王先生不要。他说：“小时候我拿了别人的东西，爸爸骂了我一顿。我记住了：要诚实。”

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 马克，你怎么了？
lines.py: Mǎkè, nǐ zěnme le?
lines.en: Mark, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 别问了，今天倒霉透了！
lines.py: Bié wèn le, jīntiān dǎoméi tòu le!
lines.en: Don't ask. Today has been a total disaster!

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 怎么回事？
lines.py: Zěnme huí shì?
lines.en: What happened?

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 早上我的电脑坏了，功课没做完。
lines.py: Zǎoshang wǒ de diànnǎo huài le, gōngkè méi zuò wán.
lines.en: This morning my computer broke, and I didn't finish my homework.

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 还有呢？
lines.py: Hái yǒu ne?
lines.en: What else?

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 中午我去银行取钱，有人偷了我的钱包！
lines.py: Zhōngwǔ wǒ qù yínháng qǔ qián, yǒu rén tōu le wǒ de qiánbāo!
lines.en: At noon I went to the bank to get money out, and someone stole my wallet!

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 钱多吗？
lines.py: Qián duō ma?
lines.en: Was there much money in it?

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 不多，可是现在我吃午饭的钱都不够了。
lines.py: Bù duō, kěshì xiànzài wǒ chī wǔfàn de qián dōu bù gòu le.
lines.en: Not much, but now I don't even have enough for lunch.

lines.speaker: 王小明
lines.zh: 别着急，我请你吃午饭。
lines.py: Bié zháojí, wǒ qǐng nǐ chī wǔfàn.
lines.en: Don't worry, I'll buy you lunch.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 谢谢！你的运气比我好多了！
lines.py: Xièxie! Nǐ de yùnqi bǐ wǒ hǎoduō le!
lines.en: Thanks! Your luck is much better than mine!

questions.en: How has Mark's day been?
What broke this morning?
What happened to Mark's wallet?
Who is buying Mark lunch?

passages.text: 马克，你怎么了？别问了，今天倒霉透了！怎么回事？早上我的电脑坏了，功课没做完。还有呢？中午我去银行取钱，有人偷了我的钱包！钱多吗？不多，可是现在我吃午饭的钱都不够了。别着急，我请你吃午饭。谢谢！你的运气比我好多了！

lines.zh: 安娜要去邮局给英国的妈妈寄挂号信。
lines.py: Ānnà yào qù yóujú gěi Yīngguó de māma jì guàhàoxìn.
lines.en: Anna needs to go to the post office to send a registered letter to her mum in England.

lines.zh: 她骑自行车去邮局。到了红绿灯那儿，她没看灯，差点儿撞了一个行人。
lines.py: Tā qí zìxíngchē qù yóujú. Dào le hónglǜdēng nàr, tā méi kàn dēng, chàdiǎnr zhuàng le yī gè xíngrén.
lines.en: She rode her bike there. At the traffic lights she didn't look at the light and almost hit a pedestrian.

lines.zh: 在邮局，她的钱不够，只好去银行取钱。
lines.py: Zài yóujú, tā de qián bù gòu, zhǐhǎo qù yínháng qǔ qián.
lines.en: At the post office she didn't have enough money, so she had to go to the bank to get some out.

lines.zh: 她说：“今天什么事儿都不顺！”
lines.py: Tā shuō: “Jīntiān shénme shìr dōu bù shùn!”
lines.en: She said, “Nothing is going right today!”

lines.zh: 可是回家以后，她发现妈妈也给她寄了信和礼物。
lines.py: Kěshì huí jiā yǐhòu, tā fāxiàn māma yě gěi tā jì le xìn hé lǐwù.
lines.en: But when she got home, she found that her mum had sent her a letter and a present too.

lines.zh: 她的运气还不错！
lines.py: Tā de yùnqi hái bùcuò!
lines.en: Her luck wasn't so bad after all!

questions.en: Who is Anna sending a letter to?

questions.zh: 在红绿灯那儿发生了什么？
questions.py: Zài hónglǜdēng nàr fāshēng le shénme?
questions.en: What happened at the traffic lights?
Why did Anna go to the bank?

questions.zh: 回家以后，安娜发现了什么？
questions.py: Huí jiā yǐhòu, Ānnà fāxiàn le shénme?
questions.en: What did Anna find when she got home?
options: A letter and a present from her mum

passages.text: 安娜要去邮局给英国的妈妈寄挂号信。她骑自行车去邮局。到了红绿灯那儿，她没看灯，差点儿撞了一个行人。在邮局，她的钱不够，只好去银行取钱。她说：“今天什么事儿都不顺！”可是回家以后，她发现妈妈也给她寄了信和礼物。她的运气还不错！

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 马克，这里有各种小吃，你想吃什么？
lines.py: Mǎkè, zhèlǐ yǒu gèzhǒng xiǎochī, nǐ xiǎng chī shénme?
lines.en: Mark, there are all kinds of snacks here. What would you like?

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 随便。那个好像很好吃。
lines.py: Suíbiàn. Nàge hǎoxiàng hěn hǎochī.
lines.en: Anything. That one looks tasty.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 小心，很辣！
lines.py: Xiǎoxīn, hěn là!
lines.en: Careful, it's very spicy!

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 味道真好！
lines.py: Wèidao zhēn hǎo!
lines.en: It tastes great!

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 糟糕，我的小吃掉了！
lines.py: Zāogāo, wǒ de xiǎochī diào le!
lines.en: Oh no, I dropped my snack!

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 真可惜！别扔在草地上，扔在垃圾箱里。
lines.py: Zhēn kěxī! Bié rēng zài cǎodì shàng, rēng zài lājīxiāng lǐ.
lines.en: What a shame! Don't leave it on the grass. Put it in the bin.

lines.speaker: 马克
lines.zh: 对，我们要保护环境。
lines.py: Duì, wǒmen yào bǎohù huánjìng.
lines.en: Right, we should protect the environment.

lines.speaker: 安娜
lines.zh: 我再给你买一个。
lines.py: Wǒ zài gěi nǐ mǎi yī gè.
lines.en: I'll buy you another one.

questions.en: What does Mark want to eat?
What does Mark say about the taste?
What happened to Mark's snack?

questions.zh: 安娜说要把小吃扔在哪儿？
questions.py: Ānnà shuō yào bǎ xiǎochī rēng zài nǎr?
questions.en: Where does Anna say to put the snack?

passages.text: 马克，这里有各种小吃，你想吃什么？随便。那个好像很好吃。小心，很辣！味道真好！糟糕，我的小吃掉了！真可惜！别扔在草地上，扔在垃圾箱里。对，我们要保护环境。我再给你买一个。

lines.zh: 我家附近有一条河。
lines.py: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu yī tiáo hé.
lines.en: There's a river near my home.

lines.zh: 以前，河水很清，河里有很多鱼，河边有很多树。
lines.py: Yǐqián, hé shuǐ hěn qīng, hé lǐ yǒu hěn duō yú, hé biān yǒu hěn duō shù.
lines.en: The river used to be clear, with lots of fish in it and lots of trees along its banks.

lines.zh: 后来有人随便砍树，河水变得不清了。
lines.py: Hòulái yǒu rén suíbiàn kǎn shù, hé shuǐ biàn de bù qīng le.
lines.en: Later people cut down the trees as they pleased, and the water stopped being clear.

lines.zh: 政府说：“我们要保护环境！大家都要栽树。”
lines.py: Zhèngfǔ shuō: “Wǒmen yào bǎohù huánjìng! Dàjiā dōu yào zāi shù.”
lines.en: The government said, “We must protect the environment! Everyone should plant trees.”

lines.zh: 去年我们在河边栽了很多树。
lines.py: Qùnián wǒmen zài hé biān zāi le hěn duō shù.
lines.en: Last year we planted lots of trees along the river.

lines.zh: 现在河水又清了，鱼也回来了。
lines.py: Xiànzài hé shuǐ yòu qīng le, yú yě huílai le.
lines.en: Now the water is clear again, and the fish have come back.

questions.en: What was the river like before?

questions.zh: 为什么河水变得不清了？
questions.py: Wèishénme hé shuǐ biàn de bù qīng le?
questions.en: Why did the water stop being clear?

questions.py: Zhèngfǔ shuō dàjiā yào gàn shénme?
questions.en: What did the government say everyone should do?
What is the river like now?
options: Clear again, and the fish are back
